description: This file is a script for auditing documentation links within a project. It contains functions to parse markdown files, resolve routes, check for broken links, and prepare directories for link auditing. It also serves as a command-line interface for triggering link audits, including anchor link checks or general link validation.

methods.name: walk
methods.description: Recursively collects all file paths within a directory, excluding hidden files.

methods.name: normalizeSlashes
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in a path string.

methods.name: normalizeRoute
methods.description: Normalizes a URL route by removing query parameters, fragments, and leading/trailing slashes.

methods.name: stripInlineCode
methods.description: Removes inline code segments enclosed in backticks from text.

methods.name: resolveRoute
methods.description: Resolves a route considering redirects and routes map, detecting loops and success status.

methods.name: collectNavPageEntries
methods.description: Recursively collects page entries from navigation configuration objects.

methods.name: sanitizeDocsConfigForEnglishOnly
methods.description: Filters and sanitizes documentation configuration objects to include only English pages and relevant fields.

methods.name: prepareAnchorAuditDocsDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary copy of the docs directory, removing translated docs, and sanitizes docs.json.

methods.name: auditDocsLinks
methods.description: Analyzes markdown files to identify broken links and missing navigation pages.

methods.name: runDocsLinkAuditCli
methods.description: CLI entry point for running the link audit, optionally checking anchors or general links.

methods.name: isCliEntry
methods.description: Determines if the script is executed directly as a CLI.
